title: Nat Kobitz as Coulthart's original Navy source

tellings.quote: Uh you know, Nat Kobitz, who was a, you know, a senior Navy scientist who was kind of Ross Coldart's original source that really brought him down the rabbit hole.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions a man named Nat Kobitz, whom he describes as a senior scientist for the US Navy. Michels says Kobitz was the original source for an Australian journalist, Ross Coulthart, who reports on UFOs, and that it was Kobitz who first drew Coulthart deep into the subject. It matters to the story because it would place the start of Coulthart's reporting with someone on the inside of the military.
